text:
Maya (oncall): seeing a wave of stalled GPU attaches in eu-west3, attach latency spiking and kubelet logs show long block-device locks :frowning:
Diego (storage): i pulled node traces, not TRIMs this time. compaction/metadata checkpointing kicked on a subset of nodes labelled `scratch-sync`. they're doing large synchronous metadata writes that hold the device mutex
Lin (sre): does the compactor run on a schedule? could coincide with cross-region snapshot replication window we started at 02:00 UTC
Diego (storage): yes — compaction + checkpoint triggers after N dirty-extents or when last-replicated-ts > 15m. replication workload increased so compactor aggressively flushed metadata at 02:05 and we got qdepth collapse
Maya (oncall): any quick mitigation besides cordoning nodes? we need capacity for a customer job landing now
ops-bot: auto-scaling policy: spare-gpu-nodes=0, can provision only by draining low-priority batches. Recommendation: postpone low-priority batch starts for 10m and throttle compactor.
Lin (sre): propose 3-step: 1) throttle compactor to run async with max-io 10MB/s 2) bump ioQuota on the two impacted nodepools 3) delay cross-region replication jobs for 5m
Maya (oncall): throttling compactor via feature-flag now: `PATCH /ops-config/compactor?limit=10mbps` applied. bumping ioQuota on `eu-west3-hot` pool.
metrics-bot: device-qdepth p50 dropped from 128->4; host-local-io-latency p50 climbed 5ms->220ms at 02:05; attach_pending peaked 34
Diego (storage): for long-term: change compactor to prefer background async metadata delta-apply and add a replication-aware backoff when attach_pending>8. firmware on some drives also delays async TRIMs during heavy metadata flush, we've had vendor notes about it
Lin (sre): cost/availability tradeoff: delaying compaction increases temporary metadata journal size and slightly increases storage write amplification; but preserves provisioning SLA. i'll add this to IR-2026-compact: runbook edits + perf test matrix
Maya (oncall): attach queue cleared after throttle+quota bump. keeping watch 20m. thanks all :thumbsup:
